notes: Resistor value: the parts list says 82 ohm but the schematic labels it 220 ohm; the schematic value (220) is used.
The breadboard image labels its upper half rows f-j, so holes in that half are named with bank 'b' (rows f-j) to match the row letters in the image.

Resistor sits in row h from column 3 to column 6; LED anode (bent leg) in column 6 row i, cathode in column 8 row i; the black GND wire ends in column 8 row h; the green pin-2 wire ends in column 3 (row g). Each column strip is shared, so the exact row within the strip does not change the circuit.
LED polarity follows the schematic: pin 2 -> resistor -> LED anode, LED cathode -> GND.

The micro USB cable is listed in the hardware list; it has no ports in the catalogue and the board entry has no USB port, so it is joined to the board without ports. The built-in LED alternative is not modelled.
Software-only elements (WiFiNINA library, access point) are not part of the physical graph.
